faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking private tours and airport transfers in Zanzibar with Ibrahim.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Message Ibrahim directly on WhatsApp for custom itineraries, special group requests, or immediate assistance.
faq.q1: How does booking with Ibrahim Tours work?
faq.a1: Booking is simple: choose your tour or transfer, submit the booking form or message Ibrahim directly on WhatsApp. Ibrahim personally reviews boat and driver availability and sends you a formal confirmation voucher within 1 hour.
faq.a2: Full payment is required to confirm your booking. Payments are accepted via Vodacom M-Pesa or direct Bank Transfer. Official payment details and invoice numbers are provided upon confirmation.
faq.q3: Are the tours private or shared?
faq.a3: All tours arranged by Ibrahim Tours Zanzibar are 100% private. You will never be paired with strangers. You enjoy a dedicated private vehicle, private guide, and private boat charter.
faq.a4: Cancellations made 24 hours or more before scheduled departure receive a full refund or free rescheduling. For weather-dependent excursions (like Safari Blue or Mnemba), rescheduling is free if sea conditions are rough.
faq.q5: Are entrance fees and snorkeling gear included?
faq.a5: Yes! All government marine reserve conservation fees, national park entry tickets (Jozani, Prison Island), professional snorkeling gear, and fresh tropical fruit snacks are included in the quoted price.
faq.q6: Do you provide airport and ferry transfers across the whole island?
faq.a6: Yes. We provide 24/7 private transfers between Abeid Amani Karume International Airport (ZNZ), Stone Town Ferry Port, and all beach destinations including Nungwi, Kendwa, Paje, Jambiani, and Kizimkazi.
faq.q7: Can tours be customized for families with children or dietary needs?
faq.a7: Absolutely! Private tours can be paced to accommodate young children, elderly travelers, or specific photo stops. Special dietary requirements (vegetarian, halal, gluten-free) are catered for during seafood lunches.
